id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_030.pack|cs_: "Thank goodness! I feared you'd vanished like your son, Son!
"Hmph. I don't know any selfish son like Son!
"Forgive him, travelers. Da lost his dear wife, and now his son is gone. He's on edge.
"Do you know of Avarith? Right after the Tree fell and darkness covered the sky, she appeared with a pack of monsters.
"We couldn't even flee, and trembled with fear. Then she gathered us in the square and said:
"'Tell me your most precious thing. I'll protect only that.'
"Terrified, we clung to her words and offered our treasures: money, beloved wives and husbands, even children...
"That wicked monster didn't protect what we offered. She carried it off!
"I can't stand liars! The Parade of Smiles will rescue the kidnapped villagers!
"Don't worry! Leave it to us! A knight never goes back on his word!
"Avarith left south with the villagers. Her lair may be there.
"I see. To rescue the villagers, let's look to the south first!"
